login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your property console.
login.rememberHint: Leave off on a shared front-desk machine.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sent: Check your inbox for the link.

error.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
error.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first — check your inbox.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.weakPassword: Choose a longer password — at least 8 characters.
error.linkExpired: That link has expired. Request a new one.
error.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured in this environment.

today.title: Today
today.subtitle: Arrivals, departures and who is in house.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Only what needs a person. Everything else has handled itself.
exceptions.unreflectedTitle: Reservation not yet in the PMS
exceptions.unreflectedBody: Created here and not acknowledged by the property management system.
exceptions.alloggiatiBody: This guest arrived more than 20 hours ago and the filing is not confirmed.

arrival.title: Arrival
arrival.missing: Missing before this can be filed:
arrival.simulated: No channel is connected — nothing is actually filed with any authority.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.subtitle: Guests waiting on a person, longest first.
conversations.noModel: No language model is connected. The assistant answers only from the property knowledge base and passes everything else to a person.

report.title: Revenue & fees
report.subtitle: What you are billed, and the evidence behind every line.
report.empty: Nothing to report for this period yet.
report.perRoomNote: Includes the percentage fees below. The number shown is the number billed.
report.issuedAt: Frozen on {at}. Later changes appear on the next statement.
report.notFiscal: This is a working statement of what BookOne bills you. It is not an invoice, not a fiscal document, and nothing here is transmitted to any authority.

export.failed: The export could not be prepared.
export.disclaimer: Working statement of BookOne platform fees. Not an invoice and not a fiscal document.

noProperty.title: No property yet
noProperty.body: Your account is not attached to a property. Whoever invited you can add you from the team page.

bookingConfirmation.subject: Your booking at {property} — {reference}
bookingConfirmation.touristTax: Tourist tax is not included above and is collected by the property: {touristTax}
bookingConfirmation.payment: Nothing has been charged online. The property will arrange payment with you.
bookingConfirmation.help: Questions about your stay? Reply to this email and the property will answer.
bookingConfirmation.signOff: We look forward to welcoming you.

bookingRequest.subject: Booking request — {arrival} to {departure}
bookingRequest.intro: A guest asked about dates your booking engine could not price. Live availability was unavailable at the time, so nothing was quoted or held.
bookingRequest.action: Reply to the guest directly at {email}.

precheckinInvite.subject: Before you arrive at {property} — a few minutes now saves the desk
precheckinInvite.intro: You arrive at {property} on {arrival}. If you complete check-in now, you can go straight to your room.
precheckinInvite.what: It takes about five minutes: who is travelling with you, a photo of each guest's ID, and roughly when you will arrive.
precheckinInvite.why: The property is legally required to register every guest. Doing it now means not doing it at the desk.

welcome.subject: You are checked in at {property}
welcome.intro: You are checked in at {property}. Everything you need is below.
welcome.stayLink: Your stay page, with messages and checkout: {url}
welcome.help: Need something? Reply to this email or message us from your stay page.

reviewRequest.subject: Thank you for staying at {property}
reviewRequest.intro: Thank you for staying at {property}. If you have a moment, the property would value your review.
reviewRequest.signOff: We hope to see you again.

invoiceRequest.subject: Invoice requested for booking {reference}
invoiceRequest.intro: A guest has asked you for an invoice. BookOne issues no invoice and has sent nothing to any authority; the details below are the guest's own words, passed to you unaltered.
invoiceRequest.note: Issue the invoice through your usual system.

escalationAlert.subject: {guestName} is waiting for a reply
escalationAlert.intro: {guestName} has been waiting {minutes} minutes for someone at the property to answer.

dates.title: When would you like to stay?
dates.subtitle: No account needed. You will see the full price before you commit.
dates.invalid: Departure has to be after arrival.

rooms.title: Choose your room
rooms.subtitle: {nights} · {guests}
rooms.noneHint: Try different dates or a smaller party — or write to the property directly.

details.title: Who is the booking for?
details.subtitle: Only what the property needs to welcome you.
details.name: Full name
details.marketing: Send me occasional offers from this property

review.title: Check and confirm
review.name: Name
review.touristTax: Tourist tax, collected by the property
review.touristTaxChildren: Children under {age} are exempt; ages are confirmed at the property.
review.cancellation: Free cancellation — contact the property and they will confirm.
review.expiredHint: Prices may have changed. Start again and we will show you today's.

confirmed.title: You are booked.
confirmed.subtitle: {property} is expecting you.
confirmed.emailSent: A confirmation is on its way to {email}.
confirmed.next: The property will be in touch about payment and arrival.

stale.title: We cannot reach live prices right now
stale.body: Rather than show you a price that may be wrong, we would rather ask the property. Send your dates and they will reply directly.
stale.name: Full name
stale.sent: Your request is with the property.
stale.noContact: This property has not published a contact address. Please try again shortly.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.nothingNow: Nothing is charged now. The property will arrange payment with you.
payment.vaultConsent: The property will keep your card on file for its no-show policy. It is not charged unless that policy applies.
payment.failed: That payment did not go through. Your room is still held — try again.
payment.cancelledPayment: The payment was cancelled. Your room is still held.

simulated.title: Simulated payment — no money will be taken
simulated.body: This property is running on a test payment provider. You will not be charged, and no card details are collected. The booking itself is real.

checkout.title: Simulated payment
checkout.subtitle: No payment provider is connected. Nothing is charged and no card is collected — choose what should happen next.
checkout.note: This page exists because the payment integration is deliberately staged. Everything behind it — the ledger, the webhook, the confirmation — is the real path.

manage.title: Your booking
manage.refundNow: Cancel now and you get back
manage.refundNone: Cancelling now refunds nothing, per the property’s policy.
manage.window: Because you are cancelling more than {hours} hours before arrival.
manage.pastWindow: You are inside the property’s final cancellation window.
manage.notCancellable: This booking can no longer be cancelled here — please contact the property.
manage.cancelledRefund: {amount} is on its way back to you.
manage.cancelledNoRefund: No refund is due under the property’s policy.
manage.refundFailed: The refund could not be completed automatically. The property has been notified and will sort it out.

stay.title: Check in before you arrive
stay.subtitle: {property} · arriving {arrival}
stay.minutes: About five minutes. You can stop and come back — everything you enter is saved as you go.

party.heading: Who is travelling
party.hint: The property is legally required to register every guest staying in the room.
party.countryHint: Two-letter country code, e.g. IT, AT, DE, SI
party.required: The property must file these with the police, so all of them are required.

documents.heading: Identity documents
documents.hint: One photo per guest. Lay the document flat, fill the frame, and check the numbers are readable before you send it.
documents.needParty: Add the guests first, then attach a document for each of them.
documents.retention: The property deletes these once your stay is registered with the authorities. Only the receipt is kept.

arrival.heading: When will you arrive?
arrival.hint: Roughly is fine. It tells the property when to have your room ready.
arrival.saved: We told the property you arrive around {time}.

complete.heading: You are checked in.
complete.body: {property} has everything they need. Go straight to your room when you arrive.

errors.invalidToken: This check-in link is not valid.
errors.expiredToken: This check-in link has expired. The property can send you a new one.
errors.unavailable: This booking is no longer active. Please contact the property.
errors.notConfigured: Check-in is not available in this environment.
errors.upload: That file could not be accepted. Use a JPEG, PNG or PDF under 10 MB.
errors.message: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.

arrived.heading: Are you here?
arrived.body: Tell us you have arrived and you can go straight to your room. The property is notified and your registration is completed.
arrived.doneBody: {property} knows you are here. Everything you need was sent to you by email, and you can message the property below.

messages.heading: Messages
messages.hint: Ask the property anything about your stay.
messages.label: Your message
messages.isRequest: This is a request for something

checkout.heading: Checkout
checkout.body: You are due to leave on {departure}. You can check out from here.
checkout.done: You have checked out. Thank you for staying.
checkout.partial: Anything you charged at the property — the bar, the restaurant, the minibar — is settled with the property directly. It is not shown here.

invoice.heading: Do you need an invoice?
invoice.hint: The property issues the invoice. We pass your details to them and issue nothing ourselves.
invoice.sent: Your invoice request has been passed to the property.

concierge.taskRecorded: I have written this down and the property can see it. If nobody has come back to you, tell me again and I will make sure someone does.
concierge.escalated: I do not want to guess at this one, so I have passed it to the property. Someone will reply here.
concierge.escalatedOutOfHours: I do not want to guess at this one, so I have passed it to the property. The desk answers {hours}, so it may be a little while.
concierge.disclosure: You are messaging an assistant. It answers from what the property has written down, and passes anything else to a person.
